# List of Appendices

## Data Extraction Notebook - extract.qmd {#sec-extract-notebook}

The digital appendix contains the Quarto notebook `extract.qmd`. It documents the complete data extraction pipeline used in this paper.
The notebook provides the executable code and configuration necessary to reproduce the dataset used in this paper.

## Exported OrientDB Dataset - exported_database.json {#sec-dataset}

The digital appendix contains the file `exported_database.json`, which is an export of the OrientDB database used in this paper.
It includes the complete dataset derived from the GitHub GraphQL API.
